tip_caption: If you're stumped, check the hints!
tip_text: The Hints icon at the lower right of the screen can offer info to help you clear your quests.

tip_caption: Increase your Rank by gaining EXP!
tip_text:
When you go up a rank, your Energy refills.
Your max Energy also increases sometimes!

You can increase your Units' Lv 
and stats through enhancement fusion.

Gather material units in daily Otherworld quests
and when your Units reach max level, evolve them!

Evolving Units can increase
their stats and the effectiveness of their Arts!

The Metal Chickens you get from "Silver Bird of the Exploring"
offer huge XP when used in Enhance Fusion.

tip_caption: Raise your levels in the Holy Land of XP!
tip_text:
Your Units will gain huge amounts of XP
when you clear "Holy Land of XP" in the Exploring.

tip_caption: Get Keys in the Holy Land of XP!
tip_text:
Sometimes Metal Chicken keys drop when you
clear "Holy Land of XP" in the Exploring.

Get through your quests more easily with
Healing or Support Equipment Skills.

You can boost your Units' stats
with the right equipment.
At the Smith, you can enhance your equipment to improve stats and skill effects.
You can get equipment enhancement materials in daily Exploring dungeons.

You can use your recipes and materials 
at the Smith to craft new equipment.

You can get the materials you need
in the daily Otherworld dungeons.

tip_caption: Check your skill effects during battle!
tip_text: If you hold down on equipment during battle, you can check the skill effect.

When a Unit's Art Gauge is full,
flicking upward will unleash 
each Unit's unique Art!

When you attack with a Skill, 
BE (Battle Ether) drops. Units randomly absorb the BE
and this fills their Arts Gauge.

When you attack with a Skill, 
BE (Battle Ether) drops. Units randomly absorb the BE
and this fills their Arts Gauge.

Damage dealt increases when
a boss is in Break.

The boss' Break gauge goes down
as it takes damage. When the gauge is empty,
the boss Breaks and is easier to beat!

The boss' Break gauge goes down
as it takes damage. When the gauge is empty,
the boss Breaks and is easier to beat!

Using skills with higher Break
Power wears the boss'
Break Gauge down more quickly.

When a boss Breaks, all the Units'
Skills are restored, letting you use them right away.

When a boss' Arts Gauge
is full, it can unleash an Art attack.

If you time a Defensive equipment skill
with a boss' Arts attack, 
it's possible to reduce the damage taken.

tip_caption: Boost your damage with support skills!
tip_text:
When a boss is Broken,
using equipment skills to increase critical rates
or attack can result in huge damage dealt!

Make sure to use skills to heal your 
Units when their HP gets low.

Status effects on bosses
appear as icons above the HP gauge.

Status effects on Units
appear as icons above their HP gauge.

You can get Dragon Gods from
daily Otherworld quests.

You can also get Dragon Gods from 
Sign-in bonuses, sub quests, mission quests, etc.

Using food when you start a quest,
offers various benefits like
ATK or HP Bonuses.

You can make particularly effective
food at the Diner in Town.

When you find a recipe,
go to the Diner in Town to make it.

You can get all kinds of rewards
for clearing sub quests
for the Adventurer's Guild.

The further you progress in the main
quests, the more sub quests you can take.

You can get crystals the first time you meet
another player in multiplayer.
You can get a maximum of 100 rewards this way.

When you go over Rank 10, 
you can gather other players and go on quests.

When 4 players use the same food,
a special Food Boost activates, with 
effects like Luck  20.

When 4 players use the same food,
a special Food Boost activates, with 
effects like Luck  20.

If you sign-in every day, 
you can get special items like
crystals or Metal Chicken Keys.

When you sign-in a certain number of times,
you'll earn "Total sign-in bonuses" rewards
that are even better than the daily bonuses!

Taking food on a quest can
power up your units! When you just need a little more to
win, trying again with food can push you over the top!

When enhancing Units, using material units from the same
element provides an Element Bonus and extra XP!

Fire is weak to water, water to earth and earth to fire,
and each can take massive damage as a result. Make sure your party
isn't at an elemental disadvantage in battle.

When you get a new device, you can
move your game data over by publishing a
transfer code from Menu→Transfer Data.

You can earn crystals by completing certain daily missions like
"Cook Food," etc.
Check through "Home"→"Missions".

The "Info" screen is full of valuable info!
Tap the Letter icon on the Home screen
for frequent updates on all the latest news!

tip_caption: Dragon Steaks give a 10% ATK bonus!
tip_text:
The food Dragon Steak offers a 10% ATK
bonus to all allies in battle.

tip_caption: Buttered Brioches give a 10% Max HP bonus!
tip_text:
The food Buttered Brioche offers a 10% Max HP 
bonus to all allies in battle.

tip_caption: Hot Dogs give a 5% ATK bonus!
tip_text:
The food Hot Dog offers a 5% ATK
bonus to all allies in battle.

When 4 members all use cheese in multiplayer,
you can get up  20 Luck!

At enhancement lv 10, the Healing Statue "Panakeia"
heals all  allies for 1000 HP.
If the user's element is Light, the healing increases x1.5.

At enhancement lv 10, Terra Conjunction
gives all allies a 100% critical rate increase
for 10s.

At enhancement lv 10, Demonsickle Evilscythe
does 6250% Dark damage with piercing,
allowing it to damage a large number of enemies.

At enhancement lv 10, Phantom Knight Shield
reduces magic damage by 25% for all allies for 8s, 
and negates a total of 600 damage (no stacking).

At enhancement lv 10, the Shield of Dawn
reduces damage taken for all allies by 15% for 8s.
Light damage is reduced by 30%.

At enhancement lv 10,  the Mystic Arrow
deals 2500% Dark damage.

At enhancement lv 10, the Phantom Mask
reduces Dark damage by 35% for all allies for 8s.
It also negates a total of 400 damage (no stacking).

tip_caption: Win 100 times in the Arena to get Claria Heath!
tip_text:
After 100 Arena wins, you can get 
Claria Heath, which offers a 5% HP bonus
and heals all allies for 1200 HO.

Get the recipe in the Lazelgia Mountains
during the main quest, gather the materials and make it!

The remaining time left for Exploring quests
is shown on the upper right of the dungeon banner.

The remaining time left for Exploring quests
is shown on the upper right of the dungeon banner.

If you tap on sparkling areas on the Town screen,
you can get ingredients, equipment materials or Gren.

tip_caption: Listen to character voices in the Unit Tome
tip_text:
Through the Unit Tome list, you can hear
voice recordings not normally used
in battle or enhancement flow.

When the Shop shows a NEW
label, it means there's a special
deal on crystals, etc.

You can get rewards for sign-in through
the regular daily "Consecutive Sign-in Bonus"
and the more generous "Total Sign-in Bonus".

tip_caption: Read the Multiplayer Handbook and brawl!
tip_text:
The Multiplayer Handbook is full
of useful tips for multiplayer games.

Using the Bundle Download feature
at home or in other Wi-Fi areas greatly
reduces your mobile data usage.

Gather all your most-used stickers
and take them into multiplayer battles!

Show your manners with stickers in multiplayer battles.
It's more fun when everyone gets along!

The Information screen offers useful updates
on campaigns, event rewards, presents and more.

tip_caption: Listen to voicing through the Shrine Tome
tip_text:
The Unit Tome in the Shrine in town 
allows you to play Unit voice samples.
A rapid attacker with incredibly powerful skills! Since his Art can launch enemies into the air, with good timing he can cancel out enemy Arts!
A balanced fighter with the power to freeze enemies solid! Her Art is powerful and has a wide area of effect, allowing her to deal massive damage to all enemies on screen.
This breaker boasts enormous Break damage! This breaker is incredibly useful, as his skills and Art quickly Break bosses, allowing for huge damage.

Breaking your units' limits a certain number 
of times can raise their Equipment Rarity limits.

Unit limit breaks can also raise
upper limits on HP, ATK and DEF.

Breaking equipment limits can reduce
the time between skill uses (Cooldown).

% damage values shown in Skills or Arts refer to
the multiple of base values of regular attacks.
A 6000% value, then, does 60x regular attack damage.

If you match the timing of a Stun
or Freeze attack with the boss' Arts
gauge filling, you can cancel its Art!

tip_caption: Get valuable items from the Alchemist!
tip_text:
You can exchange Alchemy Stones for valuable
items like Limit Break Stones at the Alchemist!

tip_caption: Get valuable items from the Alchemist!
tip_text:
You can exchange Alchemy Stones for valuable
items like Limit Break Stones at the Alchemist!

You can raise Luck values
when you Limit Break! The upper limit for Luck values
depends on the Unit's rarity.

When you make a high-Luck Unit
leader, you're more likely to get a Luck bonus.

Using Tasmons from the Spirits of the Exploring 
dungeon as materials allows you to
raise limits on HP, ATK and DEF.

When you land a Critical, 
it does increased damage and
ignores the enemy's DEF.

The ability Regen gradually restores HP automatically.
The higher the ability Lv, the more HP is restored.

Sell Units or Equipment you get
from Hero or Equip Summons
for Alchemy Stones.

Sell Units or Equipment you get
from Hero or Equip Summons
for Alchemy Stones.

Collecting four different colors of Cheese
activates a Food Boost.

There are close-combat Units
who attack enemies directly,
and Ranged Units who attack from afar.

There are Arts effects that stack
and some that don't.

By combining different Arts with effects
such as ATK and Critical Rate bonuses,
you can deal enormous amounts of damage!

There are Skills and Arts that Freeze enemies.
Freezing enemies keeps them from moving.

There are Skills and Arts that Burn enemies.
Burning enemies take gradual damage.

The Sick status ailment reduces HP healing amounts.
Be careful of your Heal timing with Sick Units.

Swoon stops a Unit from performing any action.
Watch your Skill and Arts timing!

When inflicted with Darkness, 
attack hit rates go down.

Attacks like Poison attacks, which aren't effected by DEF,
are useful against high DEF enemies like Metal Chickens.

tip_caption: Attack and Heal with Soul Recovery!
tip_text:
Soul Recovery restores a Unit's HP
when it does damage!

A Luminous Orb can restore
all allies' HP!

When you clear the top floor of Sealed Towers,
powerful Relic equipment will always drop.

You can display battle time by setting the Time Attack display by
MENU→Game Settings→ Time Attack Mode ON.

You can set how Skills, Arts and Equipment
are used in Auto Battle through
MENU→Settings→AUTO.

You can use Stickers in the Multiplayer Lobby
and in battles.

You can use Stickers in the Multiplayer Lobby
and in battles.

When you make a high-Luck Unit leader,
you'll have a higher chances of a Luck bonus.

At Limit Break, Luck values rise only
as much as the Luck of the material units.
Everyone gets the same Luck bonus in Multiplayer.

With 100 Luck, 
you get 2 Luck bonuses.

Use Magic Attacks against enemies
who are immune to Physical Attacks.

Dragging from the Equipment Icon 
to the battle screen top
will cancel the Equipment Skill.

Units with the abilities "XX Killer"
do bonus damage against enemies
of the listed race or element.

Your cooking proficiency increases the more you cook at the Diner.
It also increases when you take food into Multiplayer.

When it hits 100, you'll no longer fail when cooking
and Great Successes will provide double the food!

Freeze will stop all movement,
even in the middle of an Arts attack. Watch your 
Skill and Arts timing!

Use Physical Attacks against enemies
who are immune to Magic Attacks.

Want that multiplayer Food Boost?
That's the time to use the "Food Please! "
sticker.

You can see other players' setups
from the Arena Ranking screen.
Check out Arena and Quest strategies!

At enhancement lv t10, Earth Goddess Staff Keion
gives all allies a 28% Break Power bonus
and gradually fills their Arts gauges for 20s.

At enhancement lv 10, Cursed Lich Hammer Baldred
does 3750% Dark Elemental Physical Damage.

tip_caption: How to get the Brilliant Blade Regracia
tip_text:
Get the recipe from the side-quest "Waking Power"
after completing the 1st section of the main quest,
gather the materials and craft it!

You'll get recipes for food and equipment by clearing
chapters 1-5 of the first section of the main quest.

You can exchange 5000 Alchemy Stones at the
Alchemist for a Unit Limit Break Stone.

You can use Alchemy Stones at the Alchemist
to get Unit Limit Break Stones,
Tasmon Keys and other valuable items.

You can exchange Gold Medals earned from
Arena battles for valuable items
at the Arena Exchange.

tip_caption: Get Regracia in Rayas' side story!
tip_text:
You can craft Brilliant Blade Regracia 
after clearing the side story 
"Waking Power". Side stories are available after clearing the 1st section.

Check Information for when major boss dungeons
dropping Relics will be available.

If someone in your multiplayer battle
is forgetting to run their game, the "Move Please! " sticker
is the perfect way to let them know!

When you're preparing food
in the multiplayer lobby,  let partners know with the
"Food please!" sticker.

tip_caption: Your Friend Limit increases with Rank
tip_text:
Once you hit Player Rank 55,
your Friend List limit increases by 5
each time you move up.

tip_caption: Get Alchemy Stones by selling Relics.
tip_text:
Relics and event equipment dropped by
giant bosses can be sold
for alchemy stones.

Some bosses unleash special attacks
when their HP falls to certain levels.

If you Break bosses at the right time,
you can stop their Arts attacks!

With 100 Luck, 
you get 2 Luck bonuses.

Arts gauges can refill even
while an Art is active.

The more you enhance Force Keratos,
the more status ailments it can cure.

If you use 4 Metal Chicken curries in multiplayer,
the Food Boost "15% faster skill cooldown"
will activate.

If you use 4 Golcat curries in multiplayer,
the Food Boost "15% faster equipment skill cooldown"
will activate.

As you progress through the quest and use 
certain units together, after some battles
they may have a special conversation.
